try: Open the project Sophia’s win made
how:
1. Open "Leads" and click Sophia Wong
2. Read the filled button at the top right, then point at it
3. Press "Open project"
expect: Her lead (Stage: Won) offers "Open project", no longer "Convert to Project". Her project opens: crumb "Lead / Projects /", the title "HDB 4-Room — Sophia Wong", chips with its number (P-2026-…) and "Whole-home renovation", the button "Stage: Setting up"; seven tabs Overview · Tasks · Schedule · Client · Design · Money · Files & notes. (If you won her before projects existed, this press makes the project now.)
in10: Different from 1.0: Won makes the project in the same press

try: See what the project still needs
how:
1. On the project’s "Overview" read the first card, "Before work starts"
2. Read each row and its button
3. Read the filled button at the top right
expect: "Before work starts · 2": "Start the project" ("When work begins on site", with "Start") and "The Deposit invoice is ready to send" ("Due on signing · ready …", its amount, with "Send"). Her Members, contract value and contract are already in place, so they are not listed. The filled button reads "Start the project" — the card’s first row.

how:
1. Read "Project info" in the left column
2. Read "With Sophia", then "Progress" and "Money" on the right
3. In "Money" press "Payment stages · 4"
expect: Project info: Number, Stage Setting up, Project type, then "Signed quote" (her OM-… number) and "Contract" ("Signed …"), each opening its record. With Sophia: "Not invited" with "Invite". Progress: Setting up (current) · In progress · Completed. Money: "From the signed quote · n lines", the Contract value and no Profit yet; the four stages read 10% · 30% · 30% · 30% with their invoice state.
in10: Different from 1.0: one page, read from her signed records

how:
1. Press "Start the project" (top right) and read the window’s four parts
2. Set "Works start on" to next Monday
3. Under "The schedule" pick "Not now"; untick "Invite Sophia to their page" and "Send the Deposit invoice · S$…" (chapters 18–20 do these)
4. Press "Start the project"
expect: "Start the project" asks everything at once: When ("HDB 4-Room — Sophia Wong moves to In progress."), The schedule (where the milestones come from, with "What you will get"), Tell Sophia ("Sophia signs in with 9765 4321.") and Money. Then "HDB 4-Room — Sophia Wong is in progress." with Undo; the button reads "Stage: In progress" and the filled button now names Needs you’s top row: "Send the Deposit invoice".
in10: Different from 1.0: Setting up · In progress · Completed (1.0: Draft · Active · Closed)

how:
1. In "Progress" press "Target end" (it reads --)
2. Pick a "Target end date" before the start and look at "Save"
3. Now pick a day about three months after the start, press "Save"
expect: "Project dates" says "When work begins on site, and when you aim to hand over.", the start you chose already filled; an end before the start reads "The target end is before the start" and Save stays greyed. Then "Dates saved"; Target end shows the date with "n days left".
in10: Different from 1.0: dates checked; one small form

try: Open Projects from the side navigation
how:
1. Point at "Projects" in the side navigation and read the tooltip
2. Click it
expect: The tooltip shows G then P; a red count sits on Projects. The listing shows tiles IN PROGRESS · NEEDS ATTENTION (red) · WAITING ON CLIENT · COMPLETING THIS MONTH · CONTRACT VALUE ("Open projects"), and the pill "Open projects (5)": Sophia’s, Ryan D’Souza’s, Benjamin Han’s, Aisha Rahman’s and Marcus Teo’s. Shalini Menon’s (completed) is not listed.
in10: Different from 1.0: tiles and a pill instead of status tabs

try: See which projects need you, and why
how:
1. Press the "Needs attention" tile
2. Read the red words under each project’s name
3. Press the tile again
expect: The list narrows to the projects with a reason — Ryan D’Souza’s and Benjamin Han’s among them. Each row leads its client line with its worst reason in red — e.g. "2 milestones overdue" (Ryan) or "Payment overdue". Aisha Rahman’s is on hold, so it shows only what a hold doesn’t pause (an overdue payment or task, a ticket). Pressing the tile again brings back Open projects.
in10: Different from 1.0: plain reasons, no health score

try: See what waits on the client
how:
1. Press the "Waiting on client" tile
2. Open Benjamin Han’s project and read its "With Benjamin" card
3. Go back, open Aisha Rahman’s and read "With Aisha"
expect: Benjamin Han’s, Aisha Rahman’s and Ryan D’Souza’s are listed. "With Benjamin" lists "Painting waits on Benjamin" (paint colours · n days so far) and what waits on his portal — "Choose your paint colours" and "Confirm that electrical and plumbing is done" — each with "Remind". "With Aisha" says "Variation order VO-1 awaits approval".

try: Find a finished project and search the list
how:
1. Open the "Open projects" pill and pick "Completed", then "All projects"
2. Type 9773 in the search box, then clear it
3. Open "Filters" (Sort · Project type · Members) and "Column settings", then close them
expect: Completed shows "BTO 4-Room — Shalini Menon" (P-2025-001); All projects shows every one. 9773 finds Benjamin Han by his phone digits. Columns include Next milestone, Progress and Last update; filters apply as you pick, with "Done".
in10: Different from 1.0: Completed is hidden until asked; no Archive

scene: A client who came straight to you
try: Add a project for a client with no lead — and meet the duplicate check
how:
1. Press "New project" (or C)
2. "Client name" Daniel Koh · "Client’s phone number" 9773 1968 · "Property type" Condo 3-bedder · "Agreed value (S$)" 36000; press "Create project"
3. In "Assign member" pick Germaine, then press "Create project" again
4. Read the question, then close it with its ✕ (not "Create anyway")
expect: The form says "For a client who came straight to you. Their details stay with the project — they never join your leads." and keeps District, address, floor area, style, rooms and a first note folded under "More details". The first Create stops at "Assign member": "Assign at least one member". Then the number is Benjamin Han’s, so "A client with this phone already exists" names him, with "Open existing" and "Create anyway".

scene: A client who came straight to you
how:

2. Open "More details": "District" East · "Property address" 12 Tampines Ave 5

scene: A client who came straight to you
try: Check Daniel Koh stays out of your leads
how:
1. Open "Leads" and search Daniel
2. Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K), type Daniel
3. Pick his result
expect: Leads finds no Daniel Koh. The studio search lists him under "Projects" (P-2026-… · Daniel Koh · 12 Tampines Ave 5, with a stage chip) and opens his project.

try: Find Sophia’s tasks and files on her project
how:
1. Open Sophia’s project › "Tasks"
2. Open "Files & notes", click one of her files, then "Back to Files"
expect: Tasks opens on "All tasks" (beside "Compliance") with the same tasks as her lead (e.g. "Send Sophia the HDB renovation checklist"); Files & notes opens on "Files", holding the files you uploaded on her lead; the viewer’s Back returns to the project’s Files.
in10: Different from 1.0: the lead’s records carry on, no copies

try: Read the project’s story in Activity
how:
1. Open "Files & notes" › "Activity"
2. Read the newest lines
expect: Her whole history is there, with "You won the lead — the project “HDB 4-Room — Sophia Wong” (P-2026-…) was created.", "You started the project — work begins …" and the dates line "You set the target end date to …".
in10: Different from 1.0: one history from first call to project

how:
1. Open ⋮ ("More options") at the top of the project
2. Press "Edit details", add " (Tampines)" to "Project name", press "Save"
3. ⋮ › "Open the lead’s record", then press the back arrow
expect: The menu offers Edit details · Open the lead’s record ("Its quotes and contracts") · Open the signed quote · Open the contract · Invite to Portal · Commission · Duplicate project · Copy Link · Delete. "Details saved" and the header shows the new name; her lead opens and Back returns to the project.

try: Reach Projects from the keyboard and the search
how:
1. Click an empty part of the page, press G, wait, then P
2. Press G then B
3. Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K) and read "Go to" and "Create"
expect: The G bar lists D Dashboard, L Leads, P Projects, T Tasks … B Price book; G P opens Projects and G B the Price book. The search window has a "Projects" chip, "Projects" under Go to and "New project" under Create.

try: Check the projects on your phone
how:
1. On your phone tap "Projects" in the bottom bar
2. Tap Benjamin Han’s card
expect: Projects in the bottom bar wears the same red count. Each project is a card (name, client · property, number · Starts … · Ends …, reasons in red); his project opens with its seven tabs scrolling sideways and, at the foot, a bar for the site: Photos · Done · Note · Message.
in10: Different from 1.0: the same product on a phone
